reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E1 and E2 describe strengthening by coherent nanoprecipitates and Hf-rich phases in different alloy systems, not Nb segregation or precipitation in eutectic HEAs. E3 reports the baseline properties of an unmodified eutectic HEA but provides no evidence for the proposed Nb effect. The mechanism linking Nb to improved boundary cohesion and ductility is unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Trace Nb addition can segregate to internal colony boundaries in eutectic HEAs
Nb segregation forms fine Nb-rich interfacial precipitates
Fine interfacial precipitates strengthen colony boundaries via precipitation hardening
Enhanced interfacial cohesion delays microcrack initiation and propagation
This simultaneously increases yield strength and room-temperature tensile ductility
